original_evidence.text:
Pre-Arrival Information
Course Registration
Once you are admitted to the University of Seoul as an exchange student, the coordinators of the OIA office will contact you directly and assist you with your course registration. You may register a course or drop a course online during the course change period, the first week of each semester. Normally, course registration and changes are done through the website at
http://wise.uos.ac.kr.
Unfortunately, since all the instructions are in Korean, you are advised to ask for your UOS Buddy’s help.
Notice
You must print out your confirmed course registration results shown on the computer screen of the online registration and submit it to your coordinator after the course change period ends.
Please check if your name is on the final class rosters.
If you do not follow the academic regulations and fail to confirm your online registration during this period, you will be responsible for any failure in taking a course and acquiring credits or dropping a course.
Courses Only for Exchange Students Offered by OIA office
All of the exchange students are strongly recommended to take Korean language courses and at least one course in Asian studies. You will be arranged to the Korean language courses on the basis of your Korean language proficiency. Asian Studies courses will be taught in English. Korean Language Courses cannot be registered by students online. OIA office will register your Korean Language courses collectively within the online course change period.
Notice
Please make sure that other courses registered do not coincide with Korean Language courses when you make any changes. In case you took Korean language level test, your schedule could be changed according to the result of the test.
Graduates students are not able to do the online course registration with these courses offered by OIA office. Please let your coordinator know if you take these courses.
Regular Courses Offered in English and in Korean
Some of the regular courses are offered in English, but many of them are in Korean. Some classes cannot be accessed because of academic regulations or class size. If this happens to you, you will need permission from the professor of the course. Please contact your coordinator at the OIA office for assistance concerning these matters. You can ask your UOS buddy where your classrooms are.
Transportation to UOS
1
Incheon International Airport
By Limousine Bus from Incheon International Airport
You are advised to find the bus stop "5B” at the exit of Incheon International Airport Terminal 1 and the bus stop “No.34” of Terminal 2.
The limousine, #6002, will take you to Cheongryangni, the bus's final destination. The fare of limousine is 17,000 KRW. You may
1) Get off at the Cheongryangni stop and take a taxi or take a bus to the University of Seoul, or 2) Wait a little while until the bus heads to the next stop and the next stop will be University of Seoul.
By Taxi/Call Van from Incheon International Airport
From the airport, it costs approximately 80,000 - 90,000 KRW by taxi up for 4 people to the University of Seoul. The fare of regular taxi starts from 4,800 KRW, while deluxe taxis start from 6,500 KRW.
By Subway from Incheon International Airport
You will have to make a transfer at Seoul station (line1).
Incheon International Airport Public Transportation Guide
2
Kimpo International Airport
By Subway from Kimpo International Airport
If your flight arrives at Kimpo International Airport you are advised to use subway (Line 5). Get off at Dapsimni station which is the closest station from University of Seoul and take a taxi to the University of Seoul at Exit 3 or 4. The taxi fare from Dapsimni station to the University of Seoul (pronounced 'Seoul Sirip Dae-hak-kyo', 서울시립대학교 in Korean) is around 7,000 KRW.
Gimpo International Airport Subway Usage Guide
By Taxi/Call Van from Kimpo International Airport시
From the airport, it costs approximately 40,000 - 50,000 KRW by taxi up for 4 people to the University of Seoul. The fare of regular taxi starts from 4,800 KRW, while deluxe taxis start from 6,500 KRW.

IMPORTANT NOTES
Housing Guarantee
UOS guarantees on-campus housing only for exchange students whose                             universities guarantee on-campus housing for UOS students.
ISEP students are assigned to stay on-campus housing.

Due to a shortage of dormitory rooms, UOS cannot guarantee on-campus housing                             for all partner universities. Please confirm your housing options with your home                             university coordinator before completing the UOS online application.

What Exchange Students Should Know About Course Registration
답변
For STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics), Architecture, Economics, and Design courses, enrollment is not guaranteed for exchange students whose majors are different.
Admission to these courses is reviewed case by case. Professors and academic staff will consider your major and academic record from your home university before approving enrollment.
Please note that some courses may not be offered every semester. The availability of English-taught courses depends on faculty decisions, so courses listed now may become unavailable in future semesters.
In addition, some courses are restricted to specific majors only, such as:
- Electrical and Computer Engineering majors only
- Architecture majors only
- Materials Science and Engineering majors only
- Business majors only
During the course registration period, courses have a limited number of seats for exchange students. If a course is already full, you may only register if a seat becomes available during the first week of the semester.
Updated syllabi will be provided during the course registration period.

The certificate must be written in English, and your name, along with the two vaccination dates, should be clearly visible on a single page.

If your local health department or hospital is unable to issue this certificate, you will need to consult with a doctor.
The doctor must provide a statement confirming that you have antibodies or clear indications of immunity from two MMR vaccinations.
If provided by a doctor, the medical certificate must include a statement confirming that you possess immunity antibodies from the second dose of the MMR vaccine.
(If the original documents are not in English, a seal from a qualified translator is sufficient for translated documents.)
Generally, as long as you have received two doses of the measles vaccination, it will be sufficient!
If you can provide your vaccination certificate, it will help expedite the verification process. (Highly recommended.)
Certificate of Health (Chest X-Ray Result or TB Test Result)
You will also need to provide a document from a hospital or clinic pertaining to a chest X-ray result or a TB (Tuberculosis) test result.
(If the original documents are not in English, a seal from a qualified translator is sufficient for translated documents.)
Please note that final approval is at the discretion of the dormitory team, so it is essential that all information, including the two vaccination dates, is clearly legible from their perspective.

National Health Insurance Service (NHIS) Enrollment and Important Information for International Students
1. Automatic Enrollment
Starting March 2021, all non-Korean international students, including exchange and visiting students, are mandatory and automatically enrolled in Korea’s National Health Insurance upon the date of alien registration.
2. Consequences of Non-Payment
Restrictions on Health Insurance Benefits
Health insurance benefits at medical institutions will be unavailable starting from the first day of the month following the payment deadline until the outstanding contributions are fully paid.
Restrictions on Visa Extension
Non-payment may result in the denial of visa extensions by the Korean Immigration Office.
Compulsory Collection
If the insurance contributions are not paid by the specified deadline, the NHIS may initiate compulsory collection procedures.
This may include seizing assets such as real estate, vehicles, bank deposits, etc.
3. Important Note
For all insurance-related inquiries, please contact the NHIS directly. Our office cannot assist with these matters.
NHIS Contact Information

After Arrival Information
Orientation for New Comers
Right before each semester starts, there is an orientation session for all the new comers for spring or fall semester. The orientation covers the following topics
About University of Seoul
Academic Calendar
Academic Regulations
Class Schedules & Classrooms
UOS PORTAL System
UOS Tutor
Korean Language Classes by KLCP
Global Internship Program with Lotte Hotel Seoul
Opening an account at on-campus bank
General information; Campus Life & Living in Korea
Alien Registration Application
On-campus Housing
Go to Housing
Alien Registration after Arrival in Korea
All foreigners planning to stay in Korea for more than 90 days must report to the Seoul Immigration Office (89-4, Kyoungun-dong, Jongno-gu, Tel : 732-6214, 6215) and register for the Alien Registration Card (외국인등록증) within 90 days from the date of arrival. To apply for the Alien Registration Card, you need a long term visa.
Within the orientation session for new exchange students, you will submit all the documents which are required to complete the Alien Registration. The documents are listed below;
1. Alien Registration Form (form will be given at the OT)
2. Passport
3. Certificate of Attendance: issuable from the Student Service Center
4. Two Recent Passport-size Color Photos: 3cm x 4cm
5. Application Fee: 30,000 won
In takes approximately 7 business days for the Immigration Office to process the application. Applicants must leave their passport with the Immigration Office during this period and the office will return it when the applications is completed. If the Alien Registration Card is lost, stolen, damaged, or destroyed; or if the applicant needs to change any information on the card or if the card runs out of spaces for additional information or changes, the applicant must visit Seoul Immigration office and apply for re-issuance or change the card within 14 days. Foreigners must always carry their Alien Registration Card or their passport with them.

답변
Certificate of MMR (Measles, Mumps, and Rubella)
To meet the requirements, your Certificate of MMR must include two clearly visible dates for your MMR vaccinations.
The certificate must be written in English, and your name, along with the two vaccination dates, should be clearly visible on a single page.
(If the original documents are not in English, a seal from a qualified translator is sufficient for translated documents.)
If your local health department or hospital is unable to issue this certificate, you will need to consult with a doctor.
The doctor must provide a statement confirming that you have antibodies or clear indications of immunity from two MMR vaccinations.
If provided by a doctor, the medical certificate must include a statement confirming that you possess immunity antibodies from the second dose of the MMR vaccine.
(If the original documents are not in English, a seal from a qualified translator is sufficient for translated documents.)
Generally, as long as you have received two doses of the measles vaccination, it will be sufficient!
If you can provide your vaccination certificate, it will help expedite the verification process. (Highly recommended.)
Certificate of Health (Chest X-Ray Result or TB Test Result)
You will also need to provide a document from a hospital or clinic pertaining to a chest X-ray result or a TB (Tuberculosis) test result.
(If the original documents are not in English, a seal from a qualified translator is sufficient for translated documents.)
Please note that final approval is at the discretion of the dormitory team, so it is essential that all information, including the two vaccination dates, is clearly legible from their perspective.

Starting March 2021, all non-Korean international students, including exchange and visiting students, are mandatory and automatically enrolled in Korea’s National Health Insurance upon the date of alien registration.
2. Consequences of Non-Payment
Restrictions on Health Insurance Benefits
Health insurance benefits at medical institutions will be unavailable starting from the first day of the month following the payment deadline until the outstanding contributions are fully paid.
Restrictions on Visa Extension
Non-payment may result in the denial of visa extensions by the Korean Immigration Office.
Compulsory Collection
If the insurance contributions are not paid by the specified deadline, the NHIS may initiate compulsory collection procedures.
This may include seizing assets such as real estate, vehicles, bank deposits, etc.

For all insurance-related inquiries, please contact the NHIS directly. Our office cannot assist with these matters.

Alien Registration after Arrival in Korea
All foreigners planning to stay in Korea for more than 90 days must report to the Seoul Immigration Office (89-4, Kyoungun-dong, Jongno-gu, Tel : 732-6214, 6215) and register for the Alien Registration Card (외국인등록증) within 90 days from the date of arrival. To apply for the Alien Registration Card, you need a long term visa.
Within the orientation session for new exchange students, you will submit all the documents which are required to complete the Alien Registration. The documents are listed below;
1. Alien Registration Form (form will be given at the OT)
2. Passport
3. Certificate of Attendance: issuable from the Student Service Center
4. Two Recent Passport-size Color Photos: 3cm x 4cm
5. Application Fee: 30,000 won
In takes approximately 7 business days for the Immigration Office to process the application. Applicants must leave their passport with the Immigration Office during this period and the office will return it when the applications is completed. If the Alien Registration Card is lost, stolen, damaged, or destroyed; or if the applicant needs to change any information on the card or if the card runs out of spaces for additional information or changes, the applicant must visit Seoul Immigration office and apply for re-issuance or change the card within 14 days. Foreigners must always carry their Alien Registration Card or their passport with them.

國立中央大學國際事務處為辦理各項出國計畫之申請、審查、校內程序作業、向國外各
地區姐妹校薦送及補助金撥款與核銷，在中華民國『個人資料保護法』與相關法令之規
範下，蒐集，處理及利用申請人的個人資料。國立中央大學國際事務處蒐集個人資料，
包括申請人之姓名，出生日期，性別，身份證字號，就讀學校系所，年級，語言考試成
績，聯絡電話，e-mail 等相關於申請表上所有資訊。前述個資之處理方式會以 EMAIL
或紙本方式傳遞。 
 
若申請人未提供或所提供之資料錯誤或不完整 ， 將導致國際處無法正確審查申請人之申
請案，造成申請人相關權益之損失如審查不通過等。而申請人依中華民國『個人資料保
護法』得行使相關權利 ： 請求刪除或閱讀，製作複本，停止蒐集，處理，利用。國際
資料傳輸等權利，若申請人欲行使上述權利，請與國際處聯繫。但因行使上述相關權利
而導致申請人權益受損，國際處將不負相關賠償責任。 
 
校內初審錄取後，國際處將提供個人聯絡資料(姓名、性別、系所名稱、年級、手機、
E-mail)予國際處製作通訊錄予同行同學，以互相聯絡行前相關細節。 
 
申請人勾選『我同意』並簽屬本同意書時，即表示已閱讀，瞭解並同意本同意書之所有
內容。 
個資保存五年後(自簽名日期算起)即消毀。

original_evidence.text:
GEM Trailblazer (Semester Exchange) | NTU Singapore
The
GEM Trailblazer (Semester Exchange)
programme allows international students to  either study or conduct research for one or two semesters, while gaining credit towards their home degree. We welcome applications for undergraduate and postgraduate students from our partner universities. In order to participate, students must be nominated by their home universities.
Ranked 12th in the World (QS World University Rankings)
350+ Partner Instiutions in over 40+ countries
Gateway to Southeast Asia and beyond
To apply to the Programme, you must fulfil the following eligbility criteria:
My home university has an active formal agreement with NTU
I have been nominated by my
home university
I am a full-time, matriculated
student at my home university
I have completed at least two
semesters of study at my home
university (at least seven
semesters for Direct Masters
applicants intending to read
PG-level courses )
I have a CGPA of at least 3.3/5
or equivalent
I am proficient in the English
language
If your home university does not have an agreement with NTU, you will need to check back with your home university’s exchange office regarding the availability of exchange or other options that you can consider. You may also be interested to explore the
GEM Trailblazer Summer programme
as an alternative.
Period of Exchange
Nomination period
Application period
Application outcome
Semester 1
(Fall, August - December)
1 - 15 March
1 - 30 March
Successful applicants will be notified via email about 6-8 weeks after the application deadline.
Semester 2
(Spring, January - May)
1 - 15 September
1 - 30 September
* Dates may be subject to change.
Pre-application: Nomination
You must be nominated by your home university
to the Programme. We will not review your application if we do not receive your nomination details.
Step 1: Begin your application
Upon successful nomination, you will receive an email contaning instructions and the link to the application portal. Complete your application according to our requirements so as not to hold back the outcome of your application. The full list and details of the mandatory supporting documents is found on Page 4 of the
Information Sheet
.
You will be asked to indicate your interest in a minimum of 10 courses in your application. These courses must be approved by your home university and deemed necessary for your academic progression. To learn more about the courses offered to exchange students, refer to the 'Coursework' tab of the
Programme Brochure
.
Step 2: Submit the application
Afer completing your application full, ensure that it is submitted no later than the stipulated application deadline. We ask that you respond in a timely manner if we request for further details or clarifications.
Step 3: Accept the Offer
If your application is approved, you will receive the E-Welcome Package approximately 6 to 8 weeks after the application deadline. Upon accepting the Offer, you will have access to the GEM Trailblazer Exchange/Study Abroad Portal, which provides
you with one-stop information and access to the relevant
admissions matters that require your attention prior to arrival.
Accepting the Offer kickstarts the admissions process that will ensure a smooth start at NTU. You will have access to the
Pre-Arrival and Welcome Guides
on the Student Intranet, which contains important information to help you prepare for your semester abroad. The GEM Trailblazer team will also advise you about matters concerning the Student's Pass, on-campus housing, course registration, and more.
NTU does not offer any scholarships or financial assistance to exchange students. You must be prepared to cover the entire cost of studying abroad for the duration of your programme. Refer to the 'Financial' tab of the
Programme Brochure
for information about the estimated expenses you should plan for.
About the DUO-Singapore Fellowship Award
(by invitation only)
The Asia-Europe Meeting's (ASEM) DUO Fellowship Programme aims to promote student exchanges between European and Asian ASEM member countries. Under this programme, the DUO-Singapore Exchange Fellowship is awarded by the Singapore Government to Singapore and ASEAN students studying in Nanyang Technological University (NTU), National University of Singapore (NUS) and Singapore Management University (SMU). The Award is also open to students
from European ASEM countries
(who come from universities with fee waiver arrangements with NTU, NUS and SMU)
The Award, based on merit, is for a pair of exchanges between a university in Singapore and its respective partner university in Europe in any academic field. Awardees will receive a maximum of €4,000 Euros for one semester of up to four months, which covers airfare, accommodation and living expenses.
This award is
by invitation only
and only applies to students participating in the GEM Trailblazer programme during Semester 1 of each academic year. The GEM Trailblazer Team will inform short-listed candidates and host universities accordingly.
Ready to explore the GEM Trailblazer Exchange programme?
Our programme brochure will tell you more about course selection, accomodation and more.
GEM Trailblazer Programme Brochure
We are here to support you in your journey to becoming a global citizen!
If you have a query about our inbound semester exchange programme, drop us an email at
GEM-Trailblazer@ntu.edu.sg
.

D AT E S  ACADEMIC INFORMATION
S T U D Y  L E V E L  
The GEM Trailblazer Exchange Programme is open to
both Undergraduates (UG) and Graduates (PG). 
P R O G R A M M E  D U R AT I O N  
Study at NTU for one or two semesters. Research has a
minimum duration of 3 months. 
M E D I U M  O F  I N S T R U C T I O N  
All courses, except language courses, are conducted in
English. 
S E M E S T E R  W O R K L O A D  
A typical course load for UG students is between three
to five courses per semester, subject to approval from
both their home university and NTU. PG students may
only read postgraduate-level courses. Each course is
generally worth three or four Academic Units (AUs).   
Students must maintain enrolment in at least one
course throughout the programme, with a  maximum 
allowable workload of 20 AUs  per semester. 
D I R E C T  M A S T E R S  S T U D E N T S  
Only Direct (Integrated) Masters students who have
completed at least   seven semesters of continuous 
study  at their home university are eligible to apply
under the UG category, to have access to advanced UG
courses in addition to PG courses.   
M O D E  O F  S T U D Y  
You can either read courses, conduct research, or opt
for a combination of both throughout the exchange.

NTU offers a wide range of undergraduate courses and
limited selection of postgraduate courses. Exchange
students are  strictly not allowed   to apply or appeal for
restricted courses.  (Refer to 'Course Matters' on page 5 
for more.)

original_evidence.text:
COURSE MATTERS
In your application, you will be asked to list 10 courses for each applicable semester. At least 50% of these courses
should be from the School corresponding to the ‘Equivalent NTU Programme’ option you select. Ensure that these
courses are approved by your home university and are integral to your academic progression.   
C R E D I T  T R A N S F E R  
You are responsible for ensuring that the NTU courses you
select are eligible for credit transfer at your home university.
Detailed course syllabi are available on the NTU website via a
simple web search. If you have difficulty finding the necessary
information, please contact the Office of Global Education
and Mobility (OGEM) for assistance. 
C O U R S E  A P P R O VA L  A N D  A L L O C AT I O N  
The courses listed in your application will be evaluated by the
offering School(s) based on the academic documents
submitted, and courses deemed suitable will be approved. In
addition to your initial course choices, you will have two
further opportunities to request approval for additional
courses.   
NTU will endeavour to allocate up to four approved courses
prior to your arrival, subject to vacancies and timetabling.   
You may make changes to your registered courses by adding
or dropping courses during the add/drop period (self-
registration phase). 
Detailed information regarding the course registration
process will be provided upon acceptance of the exchange
offer.
R E S T R I C T E D  C O U R S E S / P R O G R A M M E S  
Exchange students are  strictly not allowed  to apply for/read
restricted courses and programmes. Students should not
appeal for such courses. 
R E S T R I C T E D  C O U R S E S  
C O U R S E S  O F F E R E D  
Undergraduate courses 
UG course offerings will only be published in May and
November (for Semester 1 and 2, respectively). The previous
year's courses offered may be as a reference.
Postgraduate courses 
A limited selection of PG courses is available for exchange
students. Postgraduate and Direct Masters students may only
select PG courses from the given list, to be published in March
and September (for Semester 1 and 2, respectively). 
C O U R S E  S E L E C T I O N

original_evidence.text:
KEY THINGS TO KNOW: COURSE ENROLMENT
Due to capacity constraints,
courses offered by NTU’s College
of Computing and Data Science
(CCDS) are temporarily
unavailable to exchange students
until further notice. However,
students from partner universities
with  pre-arranged access   to CCDS
courses may still be allowed to
read these courses, subject to
availability and NTU’s approval.
Depending on your academic
requirements, suitable alternatives
may be found among the offerings
of NTU’s other   five Engineering 
Schools ↗ .          
Some courses at NTU are highly popular, and places can be
competitive across all schools. To maximise your chances of
securing a suitable course load, it is important to remain flexible
in your course choices. 
Course registration is an ongoing process that continues until
Teaching Week 2 of the semester. Even if you have not secured
enough approved or registered courses before arriving at NTU,
you will still be able to review and adjust your course plan during
the add/drop period in Teaching Weeks 1 and 2 after your arrival. 
Please note that course approval does not guarantee enrolment.
Final enrolment is subject to the availability of vacancies as well
as class and examination timetable considerations, and takes
place through a separate registration exercise at a later stage.

original_evidence.text:
O N - C A M P U S  H O U S I N G  
CAMPUS HOUSING 
Campus housing is  subject to availability and is not 
guaranteed . Places are allocated through a random
computer ballot. Fees are billed per semester, with
refunds for early withdrawal granted only under
extenuating circumstances, subject to the Office of
Campus Housing's (OCH) assessment and approval. 
Eligibility 
Exchange students taking courses may apply. Research
exchange students are not eligible because of varying
project dates. 
Application & Allocation 
After accepting your offer, apply through the GEM
Trailblazer Exchange/Study Abroad Portal.  Do not 
apply directly to the Office of Campus Housing . If you
are not allocated a room or apply late, you will need to
arrange off-campus housing. 
O F F - C A M P U S  A C C O M M O D AT I O N  
Students seeking off-campus accommodation should
begin their search well in advance of arriving in
Singapore. We recommend focusing on areas near
NTU, such as Boon Lay, Jurong West, and Jurong East. 
ALTERNATIVE HOUSING OPTIONS 
S T U D E N T ' S  PA S S  ( S T P )  
You must hold a valid Student’s Pass (STP) from
Singapore’s Immigration & Checkpoints Authority
(ICA) for the duration of your programme. Application
guidance will be provided after you accept the offer.
Travel should only be arranged after your STP is
approved. 
Fees (subject to changes): 
Processing fee: S$45 
Issuance fee: S$60 
Multiple-journey fee (if applicable): S$30 
Note: 
If your NTU programme exceeds six months, you
must undergo a health screening as per the STP
requirements. 
Exchange students holding the STP are  not 
 allowed   to engage in work activities, whether paid
or unpaid, for the duration of their stay.   
STUDENT 'S PASS 
E N T R Y  R E Q U I R E M E N T S  
Inbound travellers to Singapore must ensure they
fulfil the prevailing entry requirements.   
ENTRY REQUIREMENTS 
OTHER MATTERS
E N T R Y  V I S A S  
Students needing a visa to enter Singapore do not
need to apply separately for one. Once the Student’s
Pass (STP) is approved, the In-Principle Approval
(IPA) letter issued will include a single-entry visa for
entry to Singapore. 
A D M I N I S T R AT I V E  F E E  
As a nominated exchange student, you do not pay 
tuition fees to NTU. However, a mandatory fee of 
about S$410 (Undergraduate) or S$460 
(Postgraduate) applies.    This administrative fee 
covers student insurance, programmes and amenities, 
IT services, academic resources, administrative 
support, and social activities. Miscellaneous fees for 
the second semester will also apply for students 
nominated for full year exchange. 
Paym ent is billed before the semester starts and must 
be settled by the second week of the semester. 
* Fees are mandatory and non-refundable, include GST at the
prevailing rate, and may be subject to revision at any time. 
Vaping is illegal in Singapore.  Under the Tobacco
(Control Of Advertisements And Sale) Act, it is an
offence to purchase, use or possess these products
and/or their components.   
  
NTU is a 100% Vape-Free Campus.  The use or
possession of vapes, e-vaporisers, or substances such
as etomidate is strictly prohibited. Offenders will face
immediate termination from their programme,
further penalties under NTU and Singapore law, and
barred from applying to future exchange or Visiting
opportunities at NTU.   
A D V I S O R Y  O N  V A P I N G  &  E - V A P O R I S E R S  
VAPING IS PROHIBITED

original_evidence.text:
N T U  S T U D E N T  I N S U R A N C E  C O V E R A G E  
P E R S O N A L  I N S U R A N C E  
Enrolment in NTU’s student insurance schemes 
(comprising Group Personal Accident Insurance, 
Group Hospitalisation & Surgical Insurance, and 
Medical Scheme) is included in the fees payable by 
exchange students. Coverage under these schemes is 
mandatory, regardless of any existing insurance you 
may already hold . You should also purchase
comprehensive travel insurance for your trip to and
from Singapore and any travel during the semester. 
B A N K I N G  FA C I L I T I E S  O N  C A M P U S  
OCBC bank on campus offers banking services, with
an early closure fee for accounts closed within six
months. ATMs are available across campus for cash
withdrawals. 
O C B C  P E R S O N A L  B A N K I N G  S E R V I C E S  
M E D I C A L  A N D  W E L L B E I N G  S E R V I C E S  
Medical, dental, and counselling services are available
on campus to support your wellbeing. For after-hours
care, visit a nearby clinic, or in emergencies, go to Ng
Teng Fong General Hospital. 
G E T T I N G  TO  C A M P U S  
NTU is located in the western part of Singapore and is
accessible from Changi Airport via MRT, taxi, or ride-
hailing (Grab, GoJek, TADA, etc). Our pre-arrival guide
will provide more information. 
To ensure that your wellbeing is addressed, declare all
existing conditions (medical, physical/mobility,
sensory, neurological, learning disabilities, etc.) in
your application. You may be asked to provide medical
records or specialist reports for evaluation. 
H E A L T H / M E D I C A L  D E C L A R AT I O N S

Students needing a visa to enter Singapore do not
need to apply separately for one. Once the Student’s
Pass (STP) is approved, the In-Principle Approval
(IPA) letter issued will include a single-entry visa for
entry to Singapore. 
A D M I N I S T R AT I V E  F E E  
As a nominated exchange student, you do not pay 
tuition fees to NTU. However, a mandatory fee of 
about S$410 (Undergraduate) or S$460 
(Postgraduate) applies.    This administrative fee 
covers student insurance, programmes and amenities, 
IT services, academic resources, administrative 
support, and social activities. Miscellaneous fees for 
the second semester will also apply for students 
nominated for full year exchange. 
Paym ent is billed before the semester starts and must 
be settled by the second week of the semester. 
* Fees are mandatory and non-refundable, include GST at the
prevailing rate, and may be subject to revision at any time. 
Vaping is illegal in Singapore.  Under the Tobacco
(Control Of Advertisements And Sale) Act, it is an
offence to purchase, use or possess these products
and/or their components.   
  
NTU is a 100% Vape-Free Campus.  The use or
possession of vapes, e-vaporisers, or substances such
as etomidate is strictly prohibited. Offenders will face
immediate termination from their programme,
further penalties under NTU and Singapore law, and
barred from applying to future exchange or Visiting
opportunities at NTU.

original_evidence.text:
W I T H D R AW I N G  F R O M  T H E  P R O G R A M M E  
Before arriving at NTU 
You must inform your home university in writing of
your decision to withdraw, with NTU's Office of
Global Education and Mobility (OGEM) in copy. 
After arriving at NTU 
You must inform your home university in writing of
your decision to withdraw, with NTU's Office of
Global Education and Mobility (OGEM) in copy,
before firming up your departure travel plans. 
Withdrawals requested  after arriving at NTU  will be
counted as a utilised exchange spot. 
KEY THINGS TO KNOW:
ARRIVAL & DEPARTURE
All inbound students are expected to 
attend classes from the first day of the 
semester.   You are strongly encouraged to
arrive early in the week before classes
begin, which will give you time to settle
in, adjust to campus life, and take part in
Welcome Week activities organised for
inbound students. The inbound team will
share more detailed guidance on the
recommended arrival date closer to the
start of the semester. Arriving after the
semester has begun is strongly
discouraged. 
Course changes are not permitted after
the add/drop period (Teaching Weeks 1
and 2) under any circumstances, and
remote learning options are not available.   
If you are unable to arrive by the
recommended time, please contact OGEM
promptly with valid reasons so that we
can advise you accordingly. 
When planning your return travel, please
ensure that your flight is scheduled   after 
the official end of the semester , as
examinations may be held on the final
day. Examination dates cannot be
rescheduled. Students who miss an exam
without valid supporting documentation
will be deemed to have failed the course,
and an “F” grade will be reflected on the
transcript. 
O F F I C I A L  T R A N S C R I P T S  
Official NTU transcripts will be made available to
your home university's exchange office within two
months of completing the exchange programme.
There is no need to request these transcripts. 
A C A D E M I C  U N I T S  A N D  G R A D I N G  S Y S T E M  
NTU's courses are assigned credits based on
academic units. Most courses offered in NTU are
worth three to four AUs.
The AU is a measure of the student's workload
associated with both class attendance and
preparation. For a typical one-semester course, the
number of AU is calculated as follows:   
1  hour of lecture/tutorial per week : 1 AU   
3 hours laboratory/fieldwork per week : 1 AU 
 NTU uses the Grade Point Average (GPA) system in 
awarding grades. The Pass/Fail option is not 
applicable to exchange students. 
A C A D E M I C  S T R U C T U R E  
Academically, NTU offered a very high standard of teaching, with
engaging courses and classes that combined theory with real-world
applications, making the learning experience both challenging and
rewarding. Campus life was equally impressive: the vibrant hall
community and student activities made it easy to connect with people
from all over the world and feel part of a dynamic international
environment.
- Federico Tuti, from Technical University of Denmark (AY25/26 Semester 1 exchange student)

護法』得行使相關權利 ： 請求刪除或閱讀，製作複本，停止蒐集，處理，利用。國際
資料傳輸等權利，若申請人欲行使上述權利，請與國際處聯繫。但因行使上述相關權利

國立中央大學國際事務處為辦理各項出國計畫之申請、審查、校內程序作業、向國外各
地區姐妹校薦送及補助金撥款與核銷，在中華民國『個人資料保護法』與相關法令之規
範下，蒐集，處理及利用申請人的個人資料。國立中央大學國際事務處蒐集個人資料，
包括申請人之姓名，出生日期，性別，身份證字號，就讀學校系所，年級，語言考試成
績，聯絡電話，e-mail 等相關於申請表上所有資訊。前述個資之處理方式會以 EMAIL
或紙本方式傳遞。 
 
若申請人未提供或所提供之資料錯誤或不完整 ， 將導致國際處無法正確審查申請人之申
請案，造成申請人相關權益之損失如審查不通過等。而申請人依中華民國『個人資料保
護法』得行使相關權利 ： 請求刪除或閱讀，製作複本，停止蒐集，處理，利用。國際
資料傳輸等權利，若申請人欲行使上述權利，請與國際處聯繫。但因行使上述相關權利
而導致申請人權益受損，國際處將不負相關賠償責任。 
 
校內初審錄取後，國際處將提供個人聯絡資料(姓名、性別、系所名稱、年級、手機、
E-mail)予國際處製作通訊錄予同行同學，以互相聯絡行前相關細節。 
 
申請人勾選『我同意』並簽屬本同意書時，即表示已閱讀，瞭解並同意本同意書之所有
內容。 
個資保存五年後(自簽名日期算起)即消毀。

範下，蒐集，處理及利用申請人的個人資料。國立中央大學國際事務處蒐集個人資料，

護法』得行使相關權利 ： 請求刪除或閱讀，製作複本，停止蒐集，處理，利用。國際
資料傳輸等權利，若申請人欲行使上述權利，請與國際處聯繫。但因行使上述相關權利

original_evidence.text:
National Central University 
 
 
 
 
 
桃園市中壢區中大路 300 號 300,Jhongda Rd., Jhongli Dist., Taoyuan City, Taiwan 320 
Tel: +886-3-4207107 / +886-3-4207094 / Fax: +886-3-4203384  
 www.ncu.edu.tw / ncuoia@ncu.edu.tw 
國立中央大學國際事務處 
學生個人資料提供同意書 
 
國立中央大學國際事務處為辦理各項出國計畫之申請、審查、校內程序作業、向國外各
地區姐妹校薦送及補助金撥款與核銷，在中華民國『個人資料保護法』與相關法令之規
範下，蒐集，處理及利用申請人的個人資料。國立中央大學國際事務處蒐集個人資料，
包括申請人之姓名，出生日期，性別，身份證字號，就讀學校系所，年級，語言考試成
績，聯絡電話，e-mail 等相關於申請表上所有資訊。前述個資之處理方式會以 EMAIL
或紙本方式傳遞。 
 
若申請人未提供或所提供之資料錯誤或不完整 ， 將導致國際處無法正確審查申請人之申
請案，造成申請人相關權益之損失如審查不通過等。而申請人依中華民國『個人資料保
護法』得行使相關權利 ： 請求刪除或閱讀，製作複本，停止蒐集，處理，利用。國際
資料傳輸等權利，若申請人欲行使上述權利，請與國際處聯繫。但因行使上述相關權利
而導致申請人權益受損，國際處將不負相關賠償責任。 
 
校內初審錄取後，國際處將提供個人聯絡資料(姓名、性別、系所名稱、年級、手機、
E-mail)予國際處製作通訊錄予同行同學，以互相聯絡行前相關細節。 
 
申請人勾選『我同意』並簽屬本同意書時，即表示已閱讀，瞭解並同意本同意書之所有
內容。 
個資保存五年後(自簽名日期算起)即消毀。 
 
 
 
□我已閱讀並同意上述所有內容。 
申請人簽名:___________________ 
簽名日期:_____________________

國立中央大學國際事務處 
學生個人資料提供同意書 
 
國立中央大學國際事務處為辦理各項出國計畫之申請、審查、校內程序作業、向國外各
地區姐妹校薦送及補助金撥款與核銷，在中華民國『個人資料保護法』與相關法令之規
範下，蒐集，處理及利用申請人的個人資料。國立中央大學國際事務處蒐集個人資料，
包括申請人之姓名，出生日期，性別，身份證字號，就讀學校系所，年級，語言考試成
績，聯絡電話，e-mail 等相關於申請表上所有資訊。前述個資之處理方式會以 EMAIL
或紙本方式傳遞。 
 
若申請人未提供或所提供之資料錯誤或不完整 ， 將導致國際處無法正確審查申請人之申
請案，造成申請人相關權益之損失如審查不通過等。而申請人依中華民國『個人資料保
護法』得行使相關權利 ： 請求刪除或閱讀，製作複本，停止蒐集，處理，利用。國際
資料傳輸等權利，若申請人欲行使上述權利，請與國際處聯繫。但因行使上述相關權利
而導致申請人權益受損，國際處將不負相關賠償責任。 
 
校內初審錄取後，國際處將提供個人聯絡資料(姓名、性別、系所名稱、年級、手機、
E-mail)予國際處製作通訊錄予同行同學，以互相聯絡行前相關細節。 
 
申請人勾選『我同意』並簽屬本同意書時，即表示已閱讀，瞭解並同意本同意書之所有
內容。 
個資保存五年後(自簽名日期算起)即消毀。

Semester Exchange Program
The Semester Exchange Program attracts students from our partner universities who wish to study at SJTU for one or two semesters. To be an exchange student, candidates must be officially nominated by their home university.​
Program coordinator from partner universities will nominate students in the nomination system. Nominees will receive an application link through which they can complete the online applications.​
Soft reminder: Please do not use Gmail & Hotmail as your nomination and sign-in email. IE and Chrome are recommenced for online application.​
Fact Sheet 2026-2027
1. SEMESTER DATES
FALL Semester
:
September 2026 – January 2027
SPRING Semester
:
February 2027 – July 2027
The
registration date
is generally the Friday before the semester begins.
The
last two weeks
are exam weeks, and the exam schedule will depend on the specific courses.
Please note that the
SJTU Global College
(
UM-SJTU Joint Institute
)
has its own
Academic Calendar
2. NOMINATION & APPLICATION
2.1 Eligibility
√ A minimum GPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale.
√ HSK 5 at least for attending the Chinese Taught Course (Original test certificate required).
√ IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL 90 for attending English Taught Courses (Original test certificate not required. No requirement for native speakers).
√ Must be a full-time, matriculated student in one of SJTU's exchange partner institutions.
√ Have completed at least two semesters of study at home university to commencing the exchange period.
√ Non-Chinese citizen.
2.2 Nomination & Application Procedure
A login password to the Online Application Portal has been provided to the exchange coordinators. The nomination link is：http://apply.sjtu.edu.cn/partner/c.asp?action=partner_sign
Exchange coordinators shall
fill in nominees' information
accordingly.
To ensure the accuracy of the visa application materials, it is essential that the
Exchange coordinators
verifies the nominee's information at the time of nomination,
especially the student's first and last names
, which must match exactly as they appear on the passport, as name information cannot be changed later.
Upon successful nomination, students will receive a link to the Online Application Portal via email.
Nominated students should log in to the system and apply before the application deadline. The application guide can click
here
.
To ensure the accuracy of the visa application materials,
students
should confirm that they have completely
filled out all information on the application form
, such as passport number, date of birth, and so on.
Once the application is approved, the students will get the results via email.
2.3 Documents for application
√ Bio-page of passport
*Please ensure your passport is valid for at least 6 months from the commencement of your exchange at SJTU.
√ Resume
√ Latest transcript from the home university
√ A recommendation or nomination letter from the home university
√ Study plan
*There is no fixed template. Students can fill in the courses they are interested in. The application form will be submitted to the school for review. It is recommended that students list courses from the respective school in their study plan. The study plan is for the reference of the reviewing faculty and does not represent the final courses available for selection. Students must be flexible in their course choices, which will be based on the notifications from each school.
√ Passport-size photo
√ Language proficiency certificate (if applicable)
2.4 Application Deadline
Fall (September to January): March 30
Spring (February to June): Oct 30
3. PROGRAMS & COURSES
More than 30 schools/departme
nts at SJTU which are open to university-level exchange students to choose.
Exchange students coming to our university need to be admitted by a specific school. Once admitted,
they can only choose courses from that school
. If they wish to select courses from another school, they must obtain prior approval from the relevant faculty.
Due to limitations in the language of instruction and course capacity at our university, we need the students to be flexible in their course selection.
For the most updated information about majors and courses, please consult with the
School / Department
. Course selection is subject to the school's notification.
3.1 Restricted Programs and Courses
All courses from the
School of Medicine and Shanghai Advanced Institute of Finance
are not available to university-level exchange students.
School of Computer Science and Technology,
The number of vacancies for these courses is highly limited due to the current capacity issue.
The application for
Antai College of Economics and Management
is highly competitive, and applicants must have an academic background in economics and management-related disciplines.
Some schools, such as the
School of International and Public Affairs/KoGuan Law School etc
., do not offer undergraduate courses taught in English.If you choose these schools, you can select the English-taught graduate programs offered by the school.
Not all graduate courses are available to undergraduate exchange students, and vice versa.

. The classes are held at the
Xuhui campus
.

has its own
course selection system
for the Intensive Chinese Language program.
Course selection for the Internsive Chinese Language Program is subject to notifications from the School of Humanities.
School of Mechanical Engineering
The history of the School of Mechanical Engineering (ME) of Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU) dates back to 1913. Over the past century, the school has cultivated tens of thousands of graduates who made significant contributions to technological development and economic growth in the world, such as scientists, engineers, educators, statesmen and entrepreneurs. In the new century, the school adopted a vision of a world-class engineering school that offers the best learning experience for its students, the most rewarding working environment for its faculty and staff as well as the most effective service to the industry and society.
Schedule of
Postgraduate Courses
offered in English for
2025 Fall Semester
https://me.sjtu.edu.cn/YanJS/innotice/7571.html， for
2026 Spring Semester
https://me.sjtu.edu.cn/YanJS/innotice/7626.html

syllabus for graduate courses
can be found here: https://me.sjtu.edu.cn/YanJS/coursesInfo.html
Antai College of Economics and Management (ACEM)
There are no major restrictions for
undergraduate exchange students
. Undergraduate exchange students are eligible to choose from all English-taught undergraduate courses offered during the semester. If your Chinese proficiency meets the required level (native speaker proficiency or at least HSK 5 equivalent), you may also select from the available Chinese-taught courses, based on your individual language abilities.
Graduate exchange students
are eligible to select courses from the
Master of International Business (MIB)
program offered during the semester. (This applies only to regular graduate exchange students and does not apply to MBA exchange students, which is operated separately.)
MBA courses are only available for school level MBA exchange students.
More information about courses can be found on https://mba.sjtu.edu.cn/en/academics/academic-calendar.html
Courses are available for selection
only
by students of this college.
School of Materials Science and Engineering (SMSE)
Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU) is pioneering in setting up the discipline of Materials Science and Engineering in China, which has been composed of departments of materials science and engineering since 1997 and among which the heat treatment major was set up in 1952. The discipline of 'Materials Science and Engineering' is one of the first national first-degree subjects and has been consistently ranked top 1‰ in ESI. .
Course information can be found here
https://en.smse.sjtu.edu.cn/academics/Courses
School of Agriculture and Biology
School of Agriculture and Biology offers four majors:
Plant Science, Animal Science, Resources and Environment, and Food Science and Engineering
.
School of Agriculture and Biology has been adhering to be a high-level modern agriculture-oriented, actively exploring innovations and demand-driven agricultural science school.
School of Aeronautics and Astronautics
SAA welcomes exchange students to apply for our undergraduate program in
Aeronautics
and
Astronautics Engineering
and graduate program in
Mechanical Engineering
. Detailed course listings for these programs are available on our official website:
https://www.aero.sjtu.edu.cn/en/academics/courses.
School of Life Sciences and Biotechnology
As a leading institution in life sciences and biotechnology education and research, School of Life Sciences and Biotechnology (SLSB) boasts two first-level disciplines, encompassing a wide range of sub-disciplines including
Biochemistry and Molecular Biology, Genetics, Microbiology, Developmental Biology, Cell Biology, Bioinformatics, and Bioengineering
. With a vibrant academic community comprising over 200 undergraduates, 300 master's students, and 600 doctoral candidates, SLSB offers a dynamic and collaborative learning environment. Our sub-disciplines in Biology and Biochemistry, Molecular Biology and Genetics rank among the top 1‰ globally in ESI International Rankings, attesting to the excellence of our research and education.
Only English courses at the graduate level are available for selection, and undergraduate exchange students can choose from these courses, which include:Structural Bioinformatics(Spring),Biosafety(Spring),Cell and Developmental Biology(Fall),Genetics and Development(Fall),Microbial Infection and Immunity(Fall),Molecular Signal Transduction(Fall),Synthetic Biology(Fall),Bioprocess Engineering(Fall),Bioprocess and Bioproduct Engineering(Fall),Modern Biotechnology(Fall),Anaerobic Biotechnology and Engineering(Fall)
China-UK Low Carbon College
The Low Carbon College (LCC) is a joint initiative between Shanghai Jiao Tong University and the University of Edinburgh, dedicated to advancing research and education in low-carbon fields. As the first college in China to pioneer low-carbon research and education, LCC offers three master’s programs:
Low Carbon Environment, Low Carbon Energy, and Hydrogen Energy & Energy Storage.
Undergraduate exchange students are also welcome to select courses from these programs. All courses are taught in English.For more details, please visit our website:
https://lcc.sjtu.edu.cn/En
.
School of Media and Communication
The School of Media and Communication boasts a high degree of internationalization, with over 200 international graduate students enrolled throughout the year, hailing from more than 50 countries around the globe, including world-renowned universities.
Our institution is structured into three departments:
Journalism & Communication, Film & Television, and Cultural Industry Management
. Each department offers a range of programs at the bachelor, master, and doctoral levels, catering to diverse academic interests and career aspirations.
In addition to undergraduate and graduate programs in Chinese, we also offer
fully English-taught graduate programs including M.A. in Journalism and Communication
and Ph.D. in Journalism and Communication with a focus on New Media Studies, Exchange students are free to select courses from the corresponding programs for their studies.
School of Biomedical Engineering
BME-SJTU offers four engineering majors:
Biology，Biomedical Engineering，Electrical Engineering，Biology and Medicine
.Please find more information within official website:

mmxie@sjtu.edu.cn
Global Institute of Future Technology
The institute is named the Global Institute of Future Technology (GIFT), symbolizing a dedicated faculty cultivating gifted individuals with care and vision. GIFT is committed to breaking boundaries in learning, disciplines, and institutions, and to building a globally influential, China-rooted model of industry education integration. Its mission is to nurture strategic, globally minded leaders for future industries. The institute collaborates closely with SJTU’s traditional strengths in science, engineering, biomedical sciences, and management, working to establish large-scale, interdisciplinary research centers, and promoting an innovative model to accelerate technology commercialization.
For more information, please visit our official website:
https://gift.sjtu.edu.cn/en/
Sustainable Energy and Health Science and Technology for the undergraduate study and Graduate programs are targeted at applicants from a variety of disciplines, including Mechanical Engineering, Control Science and Engineering, Materials Science and Engineering, Mechanical Design and Automation, Power Engineering, Automation, Mechanics, Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, and Biology, etc.
All courses taught in GIFT are in English. If you want to know more about courses, please contact with:

交大迎来2026年秋季学期港澳台交换生
2026年09月14日
9月11日，上海交通大学迎来40余名来自港澳台高校的交换生，开启本学期的交流学习之旅。当日下午，学校举办新生见面会，帮助他们快速了解交大、融入校园生活。
见面会上，港澳台办公室主任尹海涛代表学校致欢迎词。他表示，学生是学校的希望、国家的未来，交大各相关部门将全力为交换生做好服务保障。他勉励同学们珍惜在交大宝贵的学习时光，积极拓展自己的边界，多参与学术交流与校园文化活动，收获知识与友谊。
港澳台办公室张宏江老师就日常管理、校园生活指南等资讯进行全面解读，帮助同学们扫除初来乍到的疑惑。随后，学生社团“和合华韵社”社长庄淮宇同学生动介绍了社团特色活动与招新情况，邀请同学们在课余时间体验中华传统文化与交大学子的青春活力。
自动化与感知学院、凯原法学院、外国语学院等接收交换生院系的负责老师也出席了本次见面会，与同学们进行了亲切交流，并就本学期的专业学习安排与注意事项进行了说明。

庄恩嘉

Semester Exchange Program
The Semester Exchange Program attracts students from our partner universities who wish to study at SJTU for one or two semesters. To be an exchange student, candidates must be officially nominated by their home university.​
Program coordinator from partner universities will nominate students in the nomination system. Nominees will receive an application link through which they can complete the online applications.​
Soft reminder: Please do not use Gmail & Hotmail as your nomination and sign-in email. IE and Chrome are recommenced for online application.​
Fact Sheet 2026-2027
1. SEMESTER DATES
FALL Semester
:
September 2026 – January 2027
SPRING Semester
:
February 2027 – July 2027
The
registration date
is generally the Friday before the semester begins.
The
last two weeks
are exam weeks, and the exam schedule will depend on the specific courses.
Please note that the
SJTU Global College
(
UM-SJTU Joint Institute
)
has its own
Academic Calendar
2. NOMINATION & APPLICATION
2.1 Eligibility
√ A minimum GPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale.
√ HSK 5 at least for attending the Chinese Taught Course (Original test certificate required).
√ IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL 90 for attending English Taught Courses (Original test certificate not required. No requirement for native speakers).
√ Must be a full-time, matriculated student in one of SJTU's exchange partner institutions.
√ Have completed at least two semesters of study at home university to commencing the exchange period.
√ Non-Chinese citizen.
2.2 Nomination & Application Procedure
A login password to the Online Application Portal has been provided to the exchange coordinators. The nomination link is：http://apply.sjtu.edu.cn/partner/c.asp?action=partner_sign
Exchange coordinators shall
fill in nominees' information
accordingly.
To ensure the accuracy of the visa application materials, it is essential that the
Exchange coordinators
verifies the nominee's information at the time of nomination,
especially the student's first and last names
, which must match exactly as they appear on the passport, as name information cannot be changed later.
Upon successful nomination, students will receive a link to the Online Application Portal via email.
Nominated students should log in to the system and apply before the application deadline. The application guide can click
here
.
To ensure the accuracy of the visa application materials,
students
should confirm that they have completely
filled out all information on the application form
, such as passport number, date of birth, and so on.
Once the application is approved, the students will get the results via email.
2.3 Documents for application
√ Bio-page of passport
*Please ensure your passport is valid for at least 6 months from the commencement of your exchange at SJTU.
√ Resume
√ Latest transcript from the home university
√ A recommendation or nomination letter from the home university
√ Study plan
*There is no fixed template. Students can fill in the courses they are interested in. The application form will be submitted to the school for review. It is recommended that students list courses from the respective school in their study plan. The study plan is for the reference of the reviewing faculty and does not represent the final courses available for selection. Students must be flexible in their course choices, which will be based on the notifications from each school.
√ Passport-size photo
√ Language proficiency certificate (if applicable)
2.4 Application Deadline
Fall (September to January): March 30
Spring (February to June): Oct 30

More than 30 schools/departme
nts at SJTU which are open to university-level exchange students to choose.
Exchange students coming to our university need to be admitted by a specific school. Once admitted,
they can only choose courses from that school
. If they wish to select courses from another school, they must obtain prior approval from the relevant faculty.
Due to limitations in the language of instruction and course capacity at our university, we need the students to be flexible in their course selection.
For the most updated information about majors and courses, please consult with the
School / Department
. Course selection is subject to the school's notification.

School of Medicine and Shanghai Advanced Institute of Finance
are not available to university-level exchange students.
School of Computer Science and Technology,

is highly competitive, and applicants must have an academic background in economics and management-related disciplines.

Not all graduate courses are available to undergraduate exchange students, and vice versa.

School of Mechanical Engineering
The history of the School of Mechanical Engineering (ME) of Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU) dates back to 1913. Over the past century, the school has cultivated tens of thousands of graduates who made significant contributions to technological development and economic growth in the world, such as scientists, engineers, educators, statesmen and entrepreneurs. In the new century, the school adopted a vision of a world-class engineering school that offers the best learning experience for its students, the most rewarding working environment for its faculty and staff as well as the most effective service to the industry and society.
Schedule of
Postgraduate Courses
offered in English for
2025 Fall Semester
https://me.sjtu.edu.cn/YanJS/innotice/7571.html， for
2026 Spring Semester
https://me.sjtu.edu.cn/YanJS/innotice/7626.html
The
syllabus for graduate courses
can be found here: https://me.sjtu.edu.cn/YanJS/coursesInfo.html
Antai College of Economics and Management (ACEM)
There are no major restrictions for
undergraduate exchange students
. Undergraduate exchange students are eligible to choose from all English-taught undergraduate courses offered during the semester. If your Chinese proficiency meets the required level (native speaker proficiency or at least HSK 5 equivalent), you may also select from the available Chinese-taught courses, based on your individual language abilities.
Graduate exchange students
are eligible to select courses from the
Master of International Business (MIB)
program offered during the semester. (This applies only to regular graduate exchange students and does not apply to MBA exchange students, which is operated separately.)
MBA courses are only available for school level MBA exchange students.
More information about courses can be found on https://mba.sjtu.edu.cn/en/academics/academic-calendar.html
Courses are available for selection
only
by students of this college.
School of Materials Science and Engineering (SMSE)
Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU) is pioneering in setting up the discipline of Materials Science and Engineering in China, which has been composed of departments of materials science and engineering since 1997 and among which the heat treatment major was set up in 1952. The discipline of 'Materials Science and Engineering' is one of the first national first-degree subjects and has been consistently ranked top 1‰ in ESI. .
Course information can be found here
https://en.smse.sjtu.edu.cn/academics/Courses
School of Agriculture and Biology
School of Agriculture and Biology offers four majors:
Plant Science, Animal Science, Resources and Environment, and Food Science and Engineering
.
School of Agriculture and Biology has been adhering to be a high-level modern agriculture-oriented, actively exploring innovations and demand-driven agricultural science school.
School of Aeronautics and Astronautics
SAA welcomes exchange students to apply for our undergraduate program in
Aeronautics
and
Astronautics Engineering
and graduate program in
Mechanical Engineering
. Detailed course listings for these programs are available on our official website:
https://www.aero.sjtu.edu.cn/en/academics/courses.
School of Life Sciences and Biotechnology
As a leading institution in life sciences and biotechnology education and research, School of Life Sciences and Biotechnology (SLSB) boasts two first-level disciplines, encompassing a wide range of sub-disciplines including
Biochemistry and Molecular Biology, Genetics, Microbiology, Developmental Biology, Cell Biology, Bioinformatics, and Bioengineering
. With a vibrant academic community comprising over 200 undergraduates, 300 master's students, and 600 doctoral candidates, SLSB offers a dynamic and collaborative learning environment. Our sub-disciplines in Biology and Biochemistry, Molecular Biology and Genetics rank among the top 1‰ globally in ESI International Rankings, attesting to the excellence of our research and education.
Only English courses at the graduate level are available for selection, and undergraduate exchange students can choose from these courses, which include:Structural Bioinformatics(Spring),Biosafety(Spring),Cell and Developmental Biology(Fall),Genetics and Development(Fall),Microbial Infection and Immunity(Fall),Molecular Signal Transduction(Fall),Synthetic Biology(Fall),Bioprocess Engineering(Fall),Bioprocess and Bioproduct Engineering(Fall),Modern Biotechnology(Fall),Anaerobic Biotechnology and Engineering(Fall)
China-UK Low Carbon College
The Low Carbon College (LCC) is a joint initiative between Shanghai Jiao Tong University and the University of Edinburgh, dedicated to advancing research and education in low-carbon fields. As the first college in China to pioneer low-carbon research and education, LCC offers three master’s programs:
Low Carbon Environment, Low Carbon Energy, and Hydrogen Energy & Energy Storage.
Undergraduate exchange students are also welcome to select courses from these programs. All courses are taught in English.For more details, please visit our website:
https://lcc.sjtu.edu.cn/En
.
School of Media and Communication
The School of Media and Communication boasts a high degree of internationalization, with over 200 international graduate students enrolled throughout the year, hailing from more than 50 countries around the globe, including world-renowned universities.
Our institution is structured into three departments:
Journalism & Communication, Film & Television, and Cultural Industry Management
. Each department offers a range of programs at the bachelor, master, and doctoral levels, catering to diverse academic interests and career aspirations.
In addition to undergraduate and graduate programs in Chinese, we also offer
fully English-taught graduate programs including M.A. in Journalism and Communication
and Ph.D. in Journalism and Communication with a focus on New Media Studies, Exchange students are free to select courses from the corresponding programs for their studies.
School of Biomedical Engineering
BME-SJTU offers four engineering majors:
Biology，Biomedical Engineering，Electrical Engineering，Biology and Medicine
.Please find more information within official website:
https://en.bme.sjtu.edu.cn/
.
If you want to know more information about the courses, please contact
mmxie@sjtu.edu.cn
Global Institute of Future Technology
The institute is named the Global Institute of Future Technology (GIFT), symbolizing a dedicated faculty cultivating gifted individuals with care and vision. GIFT is committed to breaking boundaries in learning, disciplines, and institutions, and to building a globally influential, China-rooted model of industry education integration. Its mission is to nurture strategic, globally minded leaders for future industries. The institute collaborates closely with SJTU’s traditional strengths in science, engineering, biomedical sciences, and management, working to establish large-scale, interdisciplinary research centers, and promoting an innovative model to accelerate technology commercialization.
For more information, please visit our official website:
https://gift.sjtu.edu.cn/en/
Sustainable Energy and Health Science and Technology for the undergraduate study and Graduate programs are targeted at applicants from a variety of disciplines, including Mechanical Engineering, Control Science and Engineering, Materials Science and Engineering, Mechanical Design and Automation, Power Engineering, Automation, Mechanics, Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, and Biology, etc.
All courses taught in GIFT are in English. If you want to know more about courses, please contact with:
kirstenchen@sjtu.edu.cn
4. PREPARATION BEFORE ARRIVAL
All electronic materials, including admission letters and visa forms, will be sent to the student's email address directly. We only provide electronic copies of the admission materials, and the paper version of the admission notice can be collected when the student registers for enrollment.

Due to the limited number of dormitories, on-campus accommodation is not guaranteed. Accommodation booking notifications will be sent along with the admission materials.
In case of failure to reserve an on-campus room, or if you plan to live off-campus, the average rent for one-room lodging in the campus neighborhood is 3,000 RMB per month for the Minhang Campus and 5,000 RMB per month for the Xuhui Campus.
Both the Xuhui and Minhang campuses provide on-campus accommodation options.
Due to limited capacity, the availability of on-campus accommodation is not guaranteed.

國立中央大學國際事務處 
學生個人資料提供同意書 
 
國立中央大學國際事務處為辦理各項出國計畫之申請、審查、校內程序作業、向國外各
地區姐妹校薦送及補助金撥款與核銷，在中華民國『個人資料保護法』與相關法令之規
範下，蒐集，處理及利用申請人的個人資料。國立中央大學國際事務處蒐集個人資料，
包括申請人之姓名，出生日期，性別，身份證字號，就讀學校系所，年級，語言考試成
績，聯絡電話，e-mail 等相關於申請表上所有資訊。前述個資之處理方式會以 EMAIL
或紙本方式傳遞。 
 
若申請人未提供或所提供之資料錯誤或不完整 ， 將導致國際處無法正確審查申請人之申
請案，造成申請人相關權益之損失如審查不通過等。而申請人依中華民國『個人資料保
護法』得行使相關權利 ： 請求刪除或閱讀，製作複本，停止蒐集，處理，利用。國際
資料傳輸等權利，若申請人欲行使上述權利，請與國際處聯繫。但因行使上述相關權利
而導致申請人權益受損，國際處將不負相關賠償責任。 
 
校內初審錄取後，國際處將提供個人聯絡資料(姓名、性別、系所名稱、年級、手機、
E-mail)予國際處製作通訊錄予同行同學，以互相聯絡行前相關細節。 
 
申請人勾選『我同意』並簽屬本同意書時，即表示已閱讀，瞭解並同意本同意書之所有
內容。 
個資保存五年後(自簽名日期算起)即消毀。

Semester Exchange Program
The Semester Exchange Program attracts students from our partner universities who wish to study at SJTU for one or two semesters. To be an exchange student, candidates must be officially nominated by their home university.​
Program coordinator from partner universities will nominate students in the nomination system. Nominees will receive an application link through which they can complete the online applications.​
Soft reminder: Please do not use Gmail & Hotmail as your nomination and sign-in email. IE and Chrome are recommenced for online application.​
Fact Sheet 2026-2027
1. SEMESTER DATES
FALL Semester
:
September 2026 – January 2027
SPRING Semester
:
February 2027 – July 2027
The
registration date
is generally the Friday before the semester begins.
The
last two weeks
are exam weeks, and the exam schedule will depend on the specific courses.
Please note that the
SJTU Global College
(
UM-SJTU Joint Institute
)
has its own
Academic Calendar
2. NOMINATION & APPLICATION
2.1 Eligibility
√ A minimum GPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale.
√ HSK 5 at least for attending the Chinese Taught Course (Original test certificate required).
√ IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL 90 for attending English Taught Courses (Original test certificate not required. No requirement for native speakers).
√ Must be a full-time, matriculated student in one of SJTU's exchange partner institutions.
√ Have completed at least two semesters of study at home university to commencing the exchange period.
√ Non-Chinese citizen.
2.2 Nomination & Application Procedure
A login password to the Online Application Portal has been provided to the exchange coordinators. The nomination link is：http://apply.sjtu.edu.cn/partner/c.asp?action=partner_sign
Exchange coordinators shall
fill in nominees' information
accordingly.
To ensure the accuracy of the visa application materials, it is essential that the
Exchange coordinators
verifies the nominee's information at the time of nomination,
especially the student's first and last names
, which must match exactly as they appear on the passport, as name information cannot be changed later.
Upon successful nomination, students will receive a link to the Online Application Portal via email.
Nominated students should log in to the system and apply before the application deadline. The application guide can click
here
.
To ensure the accuracy of the visa application materials,
students
should confirm that they have completely
filled out all information on the application form
, such as passport number, date of birth, and so on.
Once the application is approved, the students will get the results via email.
2.3 Documents for application
√ Bio-page of passport
*Please ensure your passport is valid for at least 6 months from the commencement of your exchange at SJTU.
√ Resume
√ Latest transcript from the home university
√ A recommendation or nomination letter from the home university
√ Study plan
*There is no fixed template. Students can fill in the courses they are interested in. The application form will be submitted to the school for review. It is recommended that students list courses from the respective school in their study plan. The study plan is for the reference of the reviewing faculty and does not represent the final courses available for selection. Students must be flexible in their course choices, which will be based on the notifications from each school.
√ Passport-size photo

Semester Exchange Program
The Semester Exchange Program attracts students from our partner universities who wish to study at SJTU for one or two semesters. To be an exchange student, candidates must be officially nominated by their home university.​
Program coordinator from partner universities will nominate students in the nomination system. Nominees will receive an application link through which they can complete the online applications.​
Soft reminder: Please do not use Gmail & Hotmail as your nomination and sign-in email. IE and Chrome are recommenced for online application.​

FALL Semester
:
September 2026 – January 2027
SPRING Semester
:
February 2027 – July 2027

registration date
is generally the Friday before the semester begins.
The
last two weeks

√ A minimum GPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale.
√ HSK 5 at least for attending the Chinese Taught Course (Original test certificate required).
√ IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL 90 for attending English Taught Courses (Original test certificate not required. No requirement for native speakers).
√ Must be a full-time, matriculated student in one of SJTU's exchange partner institutions.
√ Have completed at least two semesters of study at home university to commencing the exchange period.
√ Non-Chinese citizen.
2.2 Nomination & Application Procedure
A login password to the Online Application Portal has been provided to the exchange coordinators. The nomination link is：http://apply.sjtu.edu.cn/partner/c.asp?action=partner_sign
Exchange coordinators shall
fill in nominees' information
accordingly.
To ensure the accuracy of the visa application materials, it is essential that the
Exchange coordinators
verifies the nominee's information at the time of nomination,
especially the student's first and last names
, which must match exactly as they appear on the passport, as name information cannot be changed later.
Upon successful nomination, students will receive a link to the Online Application Portal via email.
Nominated students should log in to the system and apply before the application deadline. The application guide can click
here
.
To ensure the accuracy of the visa application materials,
students
should confirm that they have completely
filled out all information on the application form
, such as passport number, date of birth, and so on.
Once the application is approved, the students will get the results via email.

√ Bio-page of passport
*Please ensure your passport is valid for at least 6 months from the commencement of your exchange at SJTU.
√ Resume
√ Latest transcript from the home university
√ A recommendation or nomination letter from the home university
√ Study plan
*There is no fixed template. Students can fill in the courses they are interested in. The application form will be submitted to the school for review. It is recommended that students list courses from the respective school in their study plan. The study plan is for the reference of the reviewing faculty and does not represent the final courses available for selection. Students must be flexible in their course choices, which will be based on the notifications from each school.
√ Passport-size photo
√ Language proficiency certificate (if applicable)

Fall (September to January): March 30
Spring (February to June): Oct 30

. If they wish to select courses from another school, they must obtain prior approval from the relevant faculty.

Semester Exchange Program
The Semester Exchange Program attracts students from our partner universities who wish to study at SJTU for one or two semesters. To be an exchange student, candidates must be officially nominated by their home university.​
Program coordinator from partner universities will nominate students in the nomination system. Nominees will receive an application link through which they can complete the online applications.​
Soft reminder: Please do not use Gmail & Hotmail as your nomination and sign-in email. IE and Chrome are recommenced for online application.​
Fact Sheet 2026-2027
1. SEMESTER DATES
FALL Semester
:
September 2026 – January 2027
SPRING Semester
:
February 2027 – July 2027
The
registration date
is generally the Friday before the semester begins.
The
last two weeks
are exam weeks, and the exam schedule will depend on the specific courses.
Please note that the
SJTU Global College
(
UM-SJTU Joint Institute
)
has its own
Academic Calendar
2. NOMINATION & APPLICATION
2.1 Eligibility
√ A minimum GPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale.
√ HSK 5 at least for attending the Chinese Taught Course (Original test certificate required).
√ IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL 90 for attending English Taught Courses (Original test certificate not required. No requirement for native speakers).
√ Must be a full-time, matriculated student in one of SJTU's exchange partner institutions.
√ Have completed at least two semesters of study at home university to commencing the exchange period.
√ Non-Chinese citizen.
2.2 Nomination & Application Procedure
A login password to the Online Application Portal has been provided to the exchange coordinators. The nomination link is：http://apply.sjtu.edu.cn/partner/c.asp?action=partner_sign
Exchange coordinators shall
fill in nominees' information
accordingly.
To ensure the accuracy of the visa application materials, it is essential that the
Exchange coordinators
verifies the nominee's information at the time of nomination,
especially the student's first and last names
, which must match exactly as they appear on the passport, as name information cannot be changed later.
Upon successful nomination, students will receive a link to the Online Application Portal via email.
Nominated students should log in to the system and apply before the application deadline. The application guide can click
here
.
To ensure the accuracy of the visa application materials,
students
should confirm that they have completely
filled out all information on the application form
, such as passport number, date of birth, and so on.
Once the application is approved, the students will get the results via email.
2.3 Documents for application
√ Bio-page of passport
*Please ensure your passport is valid for at least 6 months from the commencement of your exchange at SJTU.
√ Resume
√ Latest transcript from the home university
√ A recommendation or nomination letter from the home university
√ Study plan
*There is no fixed template. Students can fill in the courses they are interested in. The application form will be submitted to the school for review. It is recommended that students list courses from the respective school in their study plan. The study plan is for the reference of the reviewing faculty and does not represent the final courses available for selection. Students must be flexible in their course choices, which will be based on the notifications from each school.
√ Passport-size photo
√ Language proficiency certificate (if applicable)
2.4 Application Deadline
Fall (September to January): March 30
Spring (February to June): Oct 30
3. PROGRAMS & COURSES
More than 30 schools/departme
nts at SJTU which are open to university-level exchange students to choose.
Exchange students coming to our university need to be admitted by a specific school. Once admitted,
they can only choose courses from that school
. If they wish to select courses from another school, they must obtain prior approval from the relevant faculty.
Due to limitations in the language of instruction and course capacity at our university, we need the students to be flexible in their course selection.
For the most updated information about majors and courses, please consult with the
School / Department
. Course selection is subject to the school's notification.
3.1 Restricted Programs and Courses
All courses from the
School of Medicine and Shanghai Advanced Institute of Finance
are not available to university-level exchange students.
School of Computer Science and Technology,
The number of vacancies for these courses is highly limited due to the current capacity issue.
The application for
Antai College of Economics and Management
is highly competitive, and applicants must have an academic background in economics and management-related disciplines.
Some schools, such as the
School of International and Public Affairs/KoGuan Law School etc
., do not offer undergraduate courses taught in English.If you choose these schools, you can select the English-taught graduate programs offered by the school.
Not all graduate courses are available to undergraduate exchange students, and vice versa.
3.2 Schools
You can click
here
to view information about each college. The college information will be gradually updated in the modules below.
SJTU Global College
SJTU Global College
offers three engineering majors:
Mechanical Engineering (ME)
,
Electrical and Computer Engineering (ECE)
,
Materials Science and Engineering (MSE)
.
Please note that the Joint Institute has its own
Academic Calendar
and
course selection system
.

SJTU Global College
, please select
USJTU Global College
as your first preference in the application form. Details can be found
HERE

only
by students of this college.
Course selection at the
SJTU Global College
is subject to notifications from the
SJTU Global College
.

SPEIT offers three engineering majors:

. For more detailed information, please visit the
website
.

as your first preference in the application form.Courses are available for selection
only
by students of this college.You can find a preliminary course list
HERE
.

This program is a
Chinese language learning program
that will provide different levels of Chinese language classes based on your proficiency. The courses include
listening, reading, writing, and speaking
. The classes are held at the
Xuhui campus
.
Please note that the School of Humanities
has its own
course selection system
for the Intensive Chinese Language program.
Course selection for the Internsive Chinese Language Program is subject to notifications from the School of Humanities.
School of Mechanical Engineering
The history of the School of Mechanical Engineering (ME) of Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU) dates back to 1913. Over the past century, the school has cultivated tens of thousands of graduates who made significant contributions to technological development and economic growth in the world, such as scientists, engineers, educators, statesmen and entrepreneurs. In the new century, the school adopted a vision of a world-class engineering school that offers the best learning experience for its students, the most rewarding working environment for its faculty and staff as well as the most effective service to the industry and society.

offered in English for
